what_happened: Dispatch's cited issue-log entry (iss_1791921588196_IcZKne) was independently harvested twice: once by an orchestrate conclusion-stage channel (a) dispatch in ~/Projects/BimodalLogic (commit f49576632, 'lean: record four Lean 4 measurement and syntax gotchas'), which added a generic 'Grep-Based Blast Radius' section to dependency-tracing.md, and once by this task's own dispatch record. The two repositories have no dependency edge or file_scope overlap gate, so the duplication was undetectable at dispatch time. What remains undone after the first landing: the concrete worked example (FixtureStable.lean / EUFix.lfp_induction / lfp' / 200000-heartbeat), the twelve-spelling grep recipe, and the index-entries.json leg (reachability at plan time).

Reachability question settled by reading, not assumed: planner-agent.md Stage 4 item 13 ('Surface This Domain's Plan-Authoring Gotchas Before Decomposing') already queries .claude/context/index.json for project/** entries whose load_when.task_types[] contains the dispatch's task_type AND whose keywords[]/topics[] name 'plan-authoring' -- this is the ONLY mechanism by which planner-agent reads project/** domain content, and the live example (plan-authoring-gate-collisions.md, tagged keywords: [..., 'plan-authoring'], load_when.agents: [lean-research-agent, lean-implementation-agent] -- NOT planner-agent) confirms the mechanism is real and already excludes planner-agent from agents[]. planner-agent.md's own MUST NOT clause explicitly forbids resolving this class of gap by adding planner-agent to a domain entry's load_when.agents[] (cross-domain-shared-agent hazard, context-discovery.md). This settles candidate (a) as rejected and points to tagging dependency-tracing.md's existing index entry with the 'plan-authoring' keyword as the narrowest remedy that reuses the existing mechanism with zero core-planner-agent contract change.

Plan-time tier justification was measurable rather than asserted: running suite_selection_select once over the whole Files-to-modify set per phase returned a MIXED output for phase 1 (sentinel __FULL_SWEEP__ for the markdown path alongside six real suites for index-entries.json), so the honest claim named the six real suites and omitted the sentinel. Running it per-path instead would have produced a sentinel-only claim for the markdown phase and a divergent union -- exactly the per-path-composition divergence plan-format.md warns about.

One dispatch-carried measurement is now stale and was corrected at plan time rather than acted on: the Description's 'MEASURED: the file contains no occurrence of rw, unfold, whnf or heartbeat' is false against live state (12 matching lines), superseded by the cross-repo landing the dispatch's own appended note anticipates. The dispatch's line_count framing is also stale in a second way -- the 'index-entries.json leg NOT updated' gap is the missing plan-authoring keyword, not a stale line_count (242 matches wc -l today).
